# Userflow

User onboarding software. Build product tours, checklists and more. No coding needed.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/userflow/.

## Actions

- **Create or Update a Group**: Create a new group or update an existing group (also referred to as companies in the Userflow UI).
- **Create or Update a User**: Create a new user or update an existing user in Userflow.
- **Get a Content Object** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific content object (flow, checklist, or launcher) by ID.
- **Get a Group** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific group (company) by group_id.
- **Get a User** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific user by user_id.
- **List Content** (read-only): Retrieve all content (flows, checklists, and launchers) in your Userflow account.
- **List Groups** (read-only): Retrieve all groups (companies) in your Userflow account with pagination and filtering support.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all users.
- **Track an Event**: Record a custom event for a user or group for analytics and personalization.
- **Delete a Content Session**: Permanently delete a content session including its associated progress and survey answers.
- **Delete a Group**: Permanently delete a group including all their attributes, memberships and events.
- **Delete a User**: Permanently delete a user including all their attributes, memberships, events and flow history.
- **Get a Content Version** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific content version by ID.
- **List Attribute Definitions** (read-only): Retrieve all attribute definitions for users and groups tracked by Userflow.
- **List Content Sessions** (read-only): Retrieve all content sessions tracking user interactions with content.
- **List Content Versions** (read-only): Retrieve all versions of content including survey questions and checklist tasks.
- **List Event Definitions** (read-only): Retrieve all event definitions tracked in Userflow.
- **Remove a User from a Group**: Remove a user from a group (group membership).
